messages:
Ravi: heads up — saw a tenant card showing -$9.76 'cache savings' in the cost dashboard this morning after the fallback rollout.
Nina: ugh. Negative savings reported back to customers?
Ravi: yep. panel query was simple: `SELECT tenant_id, SUM(token_cost) AS burn, SUM(cache_saving) AS cache_savings FROM econ_7d GROUP BY tenant_id`. frontend formats cache_savings as currency.
Eli: the ingestion pipeline writes negative cache_saving when amortized prefetch credits exceed hits (we subtract refunds for evicted items). the dashboard assumed savings >= 0.
Cam: oh right — the materialized view `econ_mv` has `cache_saving` as signed numeric. UI didn't expect negative.
Nina: what's the right behavior? clamp to 0 so customers don't panic, or show the negative so they know wasted prefetch is a thing?
Leah: don't hide it. Negative is actionable: tells you prefetch is costing net money. But we should surface it clearly with context and avoid using it in naive quota calculations.
Ravi: suggestion: expose three fields in the summary API: `prefetch_credits_used` (>=0), `prefetch_amortized_loss` (>=0), and `net_prefetch_savings` (signed). UI shows the first two as separate lines + a net line color-coded.
Eli: implementation plan: compute `prefetch_credits_used = SUM(prefetch_credit)` and `prefetch_amortized_loss = SUM(GREATEST(0, -cache_saving))` in the MV `econ_mv_prefetch_v1`. net = prefetch_credits_used - prefetch_amortized_loss (or simply SUM(cache_saving)).
Cam: that'll keep the tenant heatmap query cheap. we can add those as precomputed columns, no heavy join required.
Nina: UX requests: small info link "Why negative?" explaining TTL evictions/amortization, and a different palette for negative numbers (red/orange) with an inline CTA to inspect the prefetch timeline.
Ravi: also, routing change note: fallback->downgrade path is now emitting both `intent_route` and `final_route` in the route_trace. our econ join used final_route to pick model_sku, so cost attribution for intents was getting lost during rollouts.
Eli: telemetry change is minor: add optional fields `intent_route` and `route_trace` to `/telemetry/v2/invoke` payload. consumers default to `final_route` if intent missing.
Leah: we must version the schema and add migration notes. I'll open an API PR for `/telemetry/v2` and add compatibility tests. tagging @ops for deployment sequencing.
Cam: billing implications: the chargeback ledger must keep signed cache_saving exactly as ingested. UI clamping is fine for readability, but ledger rows should be untouched.
Nina: quotas: any quota that uses `net_prefetch_savings` as a soft credit will need logic to treat `prefetch_amortized_loss` as a hard deduction. Otherwise tenants could exploit negative-savings to get extra burst capacity.
Ravi: good catch. we should update the quota engine to accept two params: `prefetch_credit_allowance` and `amortized_prefetch_penalty`.
Eli: perf: adding two numeric columns to the MV won't affect 95th percentile query times much. metric: aim for tenant heatmap fetch <200ms.
Leah: ops checklist (draft): 1) land telemetry API PR; 2) deploy schema with backward compatibility for 48h; 3) update ingest consumers to populate `intent_route`/`route_trace`; 4) deploy MV change `econ_mv_prefetch_v1` after ingest switch; 5) release console UI with toggle to "Show amortized losses"; 6) run canary cohort for 24h; 7) flip rollout.
Cam: can we add a "what-if" simulation for quota preview (sticky routing vs fallback) to the console? show projected per-model unit econ and cache delta for the next 7 days.
Nina: yes — reusing route-cost-sim job but add an eviction predictor with a tunable TTL curve; show results in a separate "Projected" tab and always label it as simulated.
Ravi: I'll handle the RFC for UI wording and the sample query for previews. Eli — can you scope the MV change and provide SQL diff?
Eli: sure. SQL sketch: `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW econ_mv ADD COLUMN prefetch_credits_used numeric DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN prefetch_amortized_loss numeric DEFAULT 0; UPDATE econ_mv SET prefetch_credits_used = SUM(prefetch_credit) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id), prefetch_amortized_loss = SUM(GREATEST(0, -cache_saving)) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id);` then backfill job.
Leah: I'll coordinate migration window: avoid running backfill during billing job at 03:00 UTC. ops-bot: please add reminder.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: perform MV backfill outside billing window; add telemetry schema bump to release notes; migrate consumers in canary ring first.
Cam: thanks. tag me on the PRs and I'll review the widget mockups.
Nina: tiny UX nit — when net is negative, show a CTA "Investigate prefetch waste" that opens a timeline filtered to prefetch events.
Ravi: perfect. I'll post RFC and link it here. thanks all.
